channel.title: Best Little Sites - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Best Little Sites (comicbookmovie.com)

item.title: Glen Powell Addresses Assertions That He's The Next Tom Cruise - "That's A Losing Enterprise"
item.description: After sharing the screen with Tom Cruise in Top Gun: Maverick, many believe Glen Powell is well-positioned to follow a similar path and emerge as Hollywood's next major leading man.

item.title: RETURN TO SILENT HILL Interview: Director Christophe Gans On Adapting The Classic SILENT HILL 2 (Exclusive)
item.description: Return to Silent Hill director Christophe Gans talks to us about adapting Silent Hill 2 for the upcoming movie, bringing Pyramid Head back to theaters, and the importance of practical effects.

item.title: Move Over SOLO LEVELING: The TOMB RAIDER KING Anime Debuts First Trailer
item.description: Find out why Tomb Raider King could be the next big manhwa adaptation, just like Solo Leveling was. Could Seo Joo-Heon rise to the same iconic status as Sung Jin-Woo?

item.title: Jubilation Lee Finally Gets The Spotlight In JUBILEE: DEADLY REUNION Comic Book This April
item.description: Marvel Comics has revealed that fan-favourite X-Man Jubilation Lee will take centre stage to celebrate Asian American and Pacific Islander Heritage Month in Jubilee: Deadly Reunion #1.

item.title: SHEEPDOG Interview: DAREDEVIL Star Vondie Curtis-Hall On The Importance Of His Powerful New Movie (Exclusive)
item.description: Daredevil star Vondie Curtis-Hall talks to us about the importance and impact of his new movie, Sheepdog, which is now playing in theaters nationwide.

item.title: JUSTICE LEAGUE Director Zack Snyder Shares Sequel Storyboards Revealing Plans For Superman To Kill Lex Luthor
item.description: Justice League director Zack Snyder has shared some photos from 2016, including storyboards for his unmade sequels that feature a shocking moment between the evil Superman and Lex Luthor.

item.title: RUMOR: Marvel Studios Moving Forward With An X-FORCE Movie For The Post-AVENGERS: SECRET WARS MCU
item.description: According to a new rumour, Marvel Studios is moving full steam ahead with an X-Force movie, but is it the same project that Ryan Reynolds is reportedly hard at work on?

item.title: THE FLASH: James Gunn Responds To Demands That Grant Gustin Play The DCU's Scarlet Speedster
item.description: Responding to a fan who reminded James Gunn that fans would like to see Grant Gustin play the DCU's Flash, the DC Studios co-CEO also debunked a pretty wild "rumour" about the Scarlet Speedster.

item.title: MERCY Interview: Producer Charles Roven On Casting Chris Pratt, DCEU's Legacy, And "Amazing" 3D (Exclusive)
item.description: Atlas Entertainment President and legendary film producer Charles "Chuck" Roven talks to us about Mercy, the must-see new sci-fi thriller starring Chris Pratt and Rebecca Ferguson.
